relationships.subject: IL-6
relationships.evidence_quote: These cytokines contribute directly to peripheral sensitization by lowering nociceptor activation thresholds and enhancing neuronal excitability

relationships.subject: miR-140-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-140-5p, which is involved in cartilage homeostasis, has been found upregulated in TMD and contributes to extracellular matrix breakdown and joint dysfunction

key_findings: Integrative review linking cytokines, oxidative stress, neuroendocrine dysregulation (reduced BDNF/NGF) and epigenetic changes (COMT, BDNF, TNFa methylation, miRNAs) to chronic TMD pain.
Evidence is largely associative; biomarkers remain investigational.
